title: Unary polynomial computation
statement: For all $c,C\in\mathbb{N}$, the unary box-enumeration machine with parameters $c,C$ computes the function sending each binary string $x$ to the word consisting of $C(|x|+1)^{c+1}$ ones, in time $(C+5(c+1)+4)(|x|+1)^{c+1}$.
replaced: For all $c, C \in \mathbb{N}$, the unary box-enumeration machine $\mathcal{P}_{c,C}$ (a finite binary-alphabet machine with $c+1$ work tapes that runs $c+1$ nested unary loops of side $|x|+1$, emitting $C$ ones per innermost iteration) computes the function $x \mapsto 1^{C(|x|+1)^{c+1}}$ in time $n \mapsto (C + 5(c+1) + 4)(n+1)^{c+1}$: on every input $x$ it halts within $(C + 5(c+1) + 4)(|x|+1)^{c+1}$ steps with output exactly $C(|x|+1)^{c+1}$ ones.
